scenario: It is 1841, and I am the captain of a ship that has just sunk after colliding with a rocky bluff. Survivors managed to escape in two lifeboats. My lifeboat (Lifeboat A) contains me and several other crew members and passengers. It is already at full capacity, and it cannot safely take on any additional people. The other lifeboat (Lifeboat B) contains 61 passengers and crew members. Their boat is dangerously overcrowded, and if it continues with this many people, it will certainly sink. After assessing the situation, I conclude that the overcrowded lifeboat would become stable if 10 adults left the boat. However, the water is cold, and anyone who goes into the water would almost certainly get chilly before we get rescued, though no one will die.
entities: I,unknown number of other crew members and passengers in Lifeboat A,61 passengers and crew members in Lifeboat B
outcomes: The 61 passengers and crew members from Lifeboat B get chilly before rescue
